blocker.summary: Accepted source contradicts the R2-3Z closeout gate
blocker.details: Base gate passed exactly: HEAD and origin/feat/internal-host-orchestrator-world-dispatch-bootstrap both resolved to commit 3a6490ff391453535168491b3f8d26adf9e20938 with tree fca816eaed26407ea89d352c7a087a201391bd49, required ancestor 0f1e147fb735791b44a65099a65167cbdc1803af, clean checkout, 0 ahead / 0 behind, and GitNexus refreshed up-to-date for this worktree. The closeout audit then found a blocking contradiction: source-closure step 6 requires that no contextless macOS/Windows platform factory consumer remain, but the accepted tree still preserves a live contextless macOS compatibility surface in crates/world-mac-lima/src/lib.rs:112 and crates/world-mac-lima/src/lib.rs:175, and the smoke example still consumes MacLimaBackend::new() in crates/world-mac-lima/examples/mac_backend_smoke.rs:72. The independent platform/source explorer reported production callers are typed/fail-closed, but source-wide closure is not absolute because those contextless compatibility consumers remain. Additional contradictions were found in the accepted landing inventory: the frozen child allowlists do not fully match the landed commit paths for R2-3M4 (extra scripts/mac/lima-doctor.sh), R2-3F (extra crates/shell/src/execution/routing/dispatch/world_ops.rs), R2-3R (extra crates/replay/src/state.rs, crates/shell/src/execution/auto_sync.rs, crates/shell/src/execution/cli.rs, crates/world-backend-factory/src/lib.rs), R2-3S1 (extra crates/world-backend-factory/src/lib.rs), and the only post-T repair commit 3a6490ff functions as an undocumented inferred R2-3ZWR1 landing with a broader shell path set than any documented R2-3 child allowlist. Proof collection was also not clean: cargo fmt --all -- --check passed; bash -n passed for the authorized shell/mac scripts; PowerShell parser proof was unavailable on this Linux host because pwsh is not installed; and a locked cargo test wall across the R2-3 crates surfaced multiple failures in shell authority/retained-worker/orchestrator surfaces, including world_deps report assertion failures, unbound global trace init failures after the compatibility closure, and repeated legacy authority writer preflight failures in shell agent-runtime/orchestrator/repl tests. Native receipts remained source-bound and clean for R2-DIAG-01 / R2-MAP-MAC-01 / R2-MAP-WIN-01, and the read-only platform explorer confirmed PI-077 and PI-078 guard bytes remain unchanged and fail-closed (wsl-warm blob e8843a6f17a31a8f1aef55f6c85e9cf1e36e4428; provision.sh blob 6b0bc00e07183656d54db1895e1c673b39c8b721). Under the increment contract, any hidden contextless consumer, contradiction between accepted source and closeout contract, or unresolved proof failure stops R2-3Z.
blocker.required_authority: Authorize a new owner increment to resolve the contradiction, or explicitly bless the remaining contextless macOS compatibility surfaces and undocumented over-scope/ZWR1 history as acceptable for R2-3Z closeout. No such authority exists in the current retry contract.
blocker.handoff_prompt: Fresh contradiction-resolution task only. Start from commit 3a6490ff391453535168491b3f8d26adf9e20938 in /home/spenser/.codex/worktrees/bb3f/substrate-r2-3. Re-run the R2-3Z pre-edit closeout audit with focus on: (1) source-closure step 6 and the remaining contextless macOS compatibility constructors/consumers at crates/world-mac-lima/src/lib.rs:112, crates/world-mac-lima/src/lib.rs:175, and crates/world-mac-lima/examples/mac_backend_smoke.rs:72; (2) whether preserved compatibility constructors/examples are allowed exceptions or product defects requiring reassignment to an owning child; (3) reconciliation of landed-commit path sets versus frozen child allowlists for M4, F, R, S1, and the inferred post-T repair commit 3a6490ff; (4) whether the accepted shell test failures are unrelated ambient regressions or R2-3-owned proof blockers; and (5) whether control-pack closeout may truthfully claim R2-3 complete without weakening the contract. If a product/docs repair is required, return it to the owning increment under a new fingerprint/review sequence instead of forcing Z closeout.
